suites.description: Shown screens match the owner-approved visual authority

checks.name: four approved screens are the only approved structural authority
approved authority is honest about unmapped legacy filenames
shared visual language names the governing system and rejects drift
approved reference viewport is phone-first portrait and scales truthfully

suites.description: Unseen screens inherit the approved system instead of redesigning it

checks.name: derivation rule is explicit and derived screens are never claimed as pixel-identical
every approved screen has a structural fixture with its required regions and card traits
no approved fixture reintroduces decorative chevrons or title-only navigation

suites.description: Every required route resolves truthfully with no silent Home fallback

checks.name: core registry and explicit browser route table agree exactly
every declared route resolves to its own explicit browser state
unknown paths fail safely and keep a display-safe path
a newly declared but unmapped route is blocked rather than rendered generically
route registration rejects duplicate paths and removal leaves no residue

suites.description: Back and scroll have exactly one owner and behave truthfully

checks.name: navigation coordinator alone owns history and scroll restoration
application shell rejects competing slot owners and invalid transitions
offline and degraded shell states are explicit, not silently ready

suites.description: Loading, empty, error, degraded and offline states are truthful and complete

checks.name: every required regression state has a deterministic, provider-free fixture
status semantics always carry a textual equivalent, never colour alone
status labels and owner-facing text stay canonical and free of plumbing
offline policy keeps the shell available without faking fresh data
update lifecycle blocks incompatible activation and preserves known-good rollback
runtime renders explicit unavailable/empty states instead of fabricating zeroes

suites.description: Accessibility contracts are enforced rather than declared

checks.name: interactive targets meet the 48px minimum and require an accessible name
keyboard commands and focus boundaries behave truthfully
the accessibility contract keeps every required guarantee
reduced motion removes animation and transition budget is enforced
primitives, overlays and layers cannot break accessibility rules

suites.description: Responsive geometry and target devices keep the phone-first contract

checks.name: layout classes separate compact phone, phone, tablet and desktop
target devices stay phone-first including the accepted Samsung viewport
reference scale and motion adapt to device profile

suites.description: Browser runtime assembly carries the approved system with no legacy dependency

checks.name: browser runtime renders each approved structure distinctly
owner-facing navigation uses whole cards with no decorative chevrons
approved visual tokens and geometry are present in the shipped stylesheets
no generic UI framework or competing design system is introduced
runtime and UI modules stay inside the clean-room source with no legacy or dynamic escape hatch
